# Fine Grained Wood

Original asset by Rob Tuytel, distributed by Poly Haven under CC0.

- Asset: https://polyhaven.com/a/fine_grained_wood
- License: https://polyhaven.com/license
- CC0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
- Download URLs and SHA-256 hashes: sources.json

The unmodified 2K JPEG color, OpenGL normal, and AO/roughness/metal maps
are embedded in the cathedral's pew material. The geometry uses
world-space UVs repeated every 0.8 metres; each material map receives
runtime mipmaps. No displacement is generated.

This is an illustrative material, not a historical reconstruction.
